nodes.label: Capability State Model
nodes.rationale: Four states (supported, conditional, experimental, unavailable) derived from runtime evidence: a configured file is not proof an agent loaded or trusted it, and automation must branch on explicit capability states, never on the presence of a settings file alone.

nodes.label: Agent Capability Matrix
nodes.rationale: Per-surface matrix (Codex/Claude Code, attached/managed/cloud) over eight controls (observe, block tool, request approval, start managed, inject, interrupt, select model, select effort); cloud observation stays conditional until a real signed-delivery smoke records an event, and cloud control capabilities are never inferred from local hook configuration.

nodes.label: loopguard doctor Diagnostics
nodes.rationale: The authoritative capability report on the current machine; each surface reports vendor version, active integration source, pinned plugin checksum, hook locations, observable trust status, exact event coverage, and daemon/managed-bridge health.

nodes.label: Windows Automatic Startup (Experimental)
nodes.rationale: The current-user scheduled task (definition, SID binding, quoting, restart policy, upgrade, uninstall) is fully implemented, but LoopGuard refuses to report it as supported until named-pipe transport and current-user ACL behavior pass on a real Windows CI runner — implementation alone does not earn the supported label.

nodes.label: Safe Maintenance Boundaries
nodes.rationale: doctor --fix-safe repairs only owner-only permissions for real LoopGuard files and never changes vendor trust, credentials, policy, or unrelated configuration; uninstall removes only exact LoopGuard-owned definitions and never treats similar-looking third-party hooks or services as its own.

nodes.label: Diagnostics Bundle Redaction
nodes.rationale: Sharing diagnostics is a two-step preview-then-confirm flow (--bundle, then --confirm-bundle); the archive excludes credentials, prompts, repository names, session identifiers, and absolute hook paths, and no upload ever occurs.
